# Fluctum

> Open-source, real-time dynamic pricing plugin for Medusa. Streams live spot prices to storefronts over Server-Sent Events and locks checkout prices for order validation. Built for precious metals, industrial metals, and any catalog where market prices move constantly.

Fluctum is maintained by [u11d](https://u11d.com) and licensed under MIT. It ships as three connected, open-source components: a Medusa plugin, a backend starter, and a storefront starter.

## Key facts

- License: MIT (free, self-hostable)
- npm package: `@u11d/medusa-dynamic-pricing`
- Runtime platform: [Medusa](https://medusajs.com) v2
- Price delivery: Server-Sent Events (SSE)
- Checkout behavior: prices are locked from the latest stored spot price for a configurable window and validated again before order completion
